release_notes:
Fix: email validation rejected valid addresses with TLDs longer than 4 letters

isValidEmail() in both the admin panel and customer-facing JS capped the TLD at
4 letters, a regex written before TLDs like .online, .company, or .international
existed. Any genuinely valid email using one of these was silently rejected on
save/register with "please enter a valid email", even though the address was
fine. The server-side PHP validator already had no such limit.
